title: Temperature-controlled surface adhesion in graphene materials: experimental trends, surfaces, and interfaces physical chemistry
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,27941-27950
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03892H, Paper
Open Access

Tayssir Hamieh
Temperature-tunable adhesion of graphene, GO, and rGO is explored across solid–vapor and solid–liquid interfaces. The findings proved controllable surface energy and interfacial mechanics, enabling future applications in fluidic devices and coatings.
